title: FatPipe WAF: Practical Security and Reliable Support
summary: FatPipe WAF detects and blocks automated bots and malicious scripts, API endpoint probes, remote code execution, and requests that exploit broken HTTP protocols
body_markdown:
Customers, including online stores, portfolio websites, corporate pages, blogs, startups, and schools, don’t compromise on security, speed, and constant availability. E-commerce stores encourage customers to buy from their latest inventories online. These customers need websites that are secure, fast, and always available. FatPipe helps customers secure their digital presences and address unforeseen security risks. Attackers use exploits that can easily slip past traditional defenses. FatPipe WAF helps customers tackle adversarial attacks by scrubbing, inspecting, and cleaning network data packets at edge nodes before they reach the core infrastructure.


**How FatPipe WAF Detects and Blocks Attacks**


FatPipe WAF sets up rules that tell the[firewall](https://www.fatpipeinc.com/products/enterprise-view) what to look for and how to protect your website. These rules are applied to the websites or applications you want to protect. If hackers try to hack your website, FatPipe WAF proactively identifies and blocks their attacks. It identifies patterns that match known attack methods. Even while blocking attacks, the firewall logs all inbound traffic and enables customers can also set custom alerts for known attacks.


**Conclusion**


FatPipe WAF detects and blocks automated bots and malicious scripts, API endpoint probes, remote code execution, and requests that exploit broken HTTP protocols. It is designed to block adversarial attacks on customer online assets and protect against[DDoS](https://www.fatpipeinc.com/products/nextgen-firewall) attacks. FatPipe’s[edge security](https://www.fatpipeinc.com/solutions/cybersecurity) ensures threats are blocked without impacting legitimate business traffic. Mitigation is executed with precision, control, and alignment with business needs.
